title: Sjoelen
tagline: Slide it. Bank it. Chase the 148.
description: The Dutch table game of wooden discs with real sliding physics. Flick discs through four numbered arches, build sets of 20 and beat four rivals or a friend.
howToPlay: Drag the disc sideways at your end of the board.
Flick it up the board: speed sets the strength, angle sets the direction.
Follow the dotted guide and bank shots off the rails.
Arches score 2, 3, 4 and 1; one in each arch is a set worth 20.
Strays are slid again; perfect is 148.
